experiment: Experiment B — Synthetic Multi-Class Track Maintenance Urgency Prototype
data_nature: SYNTHETIC SIMULATED DATASET — NOT OFFICIAL INDIAN RAILWAYS RECORDS
disclaimer: This experiment is strictly an algorithmic prototype and pipeline benchmark. Results must never be claimed to validate actual Indian Railways track performance.
split_strategy: Stratified Random Split (80% train, 20% test, random_state=42)

excluded_leakage_features.risk_score: CRITICAL TARGET LEAKAGE: Continuous variable computed directly from failure state (r > 0.88 with severity)
excluded_leakage_features.maintenance_required: CRITICAL TARGET LEAKAGE: Direct binary flag indicating maintenance requirement
excluded_leakage_features.inspection_score: Post-hoc evaluator score reflecting known defects
excluded_leakage_features.delay_minutes: Operational consequence of defect occurrence rather than predictive precursor

assumptions: Dataset is purely synthetic, created for data science prototyping and code testing.
Features reflect simulated physics and environment (wear, temperature, humidity).
Leakage-prone columns must be rigorously omitted to avoid inflated synthetic accuracy.
